At coffee farms, visitors can see the main stages of production: planting, hand-picking, drying, processing, grinding, and roasting the beans. Farm tours finish with a coffee tasting and an introduction to the work of a barista.

Another major excursion from Pereira leads to the Cocora Valley. Nature trails pass among wax palms, Colombia's national tree. After the valley, the itinerary continues to Salento, exploring colonial streets, craft workshops, and viewpoints.

Pergamino is in Buenos Aires Province and offers an introduction to Argentina's agricultural heartland. Farmland around the city becomes part of the journey, while the city itself makes a convenient stop between professional visits and a place to explore local cuisine.

An INTA experimental station operates here. For agricultural delegations, Pergamino offers insights into no-till seeding, crop rotation, precision agriculture, and sustainable soil management. We include the city in professional itineraries across the Pampas and agree on the content of technical meetings in advance according to each group's specialization.
